# Synthetic fixture

These are invented values, not a captured AAII export or licensed survey history.
The categories follow AAII's official survey description. CSV is our documented
local import contract; the provider's current historical workbook is unverified.

Binary synthetic.xls and synthetic-correction.xls contain invented shares, exact
Reported/Date headers, actual Excel date cells, historical missing cells and a
summary section. They were generated by scripts/generate_aaii_fixtures.py using
xlwt 1.3.0 in an isolated temporary environment. xlwt is not a pipeline dependency.
